exposure: Levels of sTWEAK, sCD163, and sTWEAK/sCD163 ratio
cohort: 70 pregnant women in their first trimester (6-14 weeks of gestation), divided into two groups: 41 with threatened abortion and 29 controls
finding: Elevated sTWEAK levels were identified as a potential predictor of miscarriage risk in pregnant women experiencing first-trimester vaginal bleeding.
